items.title: Record which floor each unit is on
items.asked: You wanted to keep track of which floor each unit is on, and see it on the units list.
changed: Every unit now has a Floor box, next to Apartment.
The units list shows the floor under each unit.
steps: Type the floor in the Floor box.
Press Save. The floor now shows on the units list too.
items.note: Units you already have start with no floor. Fill it in as you go.

pairs.afterNote: The new Floor box, saved as 4.

items.title: Arrange the applicant page your way
items.asked: You asked to move the tabs and boxes on the applicant page so the ones you use most come first.
changed: A new settings page to drag tabs and boxes into the order you want.
Everyone on your team sees the same layout.

pairs.beforeNote: There was no way to change this layout before.
